newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese "freelance" civil servants to strike.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese "freelance" civil servants to strike.

text.p: Portuguese civil servants hired on a freelance basis will stage a one-day strike on Friday to protest against their "precarious" contracts, the Federation of Civil Service Unions (FNSFP) said.
"Freelance workers will be on strike on January 31 in order to demand their integration into the staff ranks," a statement said. "Many schools and health services, among others, will not function."

The federation said it blamed the Socialist government of Prime Minister Antonio Guterres for failing to end the freelance contracts regulating up to 10 percent of Portugal's estimated 500,000 to 800,000 civil servants.
